svg.aria-label: The 10 by 10 tile of the workgroup in the dispatch's bottom-right corner, workgroup (37, 21), whose tile starts at cell (295, 167). Its 8 by 8 cells run from x 296 to 303 and y 168 to 175, but the grid ends at x 299 and y 169, so only 8 of its 64 invocations store; the rest load and reach barrier() without storing. The one-cell border is the halo, read only as neighbours. Each entry is numbered by its index in tile[]: invocations 0 to 63 load entries 0 to 63, then invocations 0 to 35 load entries 64 to 99. Coordinates past the edge read the wrapped cell: x 300 to 304 read columns 0 to 4, and y 170 to 176 read rows 0 to 6.
